Select distinct molecule chembl_id, compound name, and canonical SMILES for compounds linked to the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by document chembl_id CHEMBL4376833 and require canonical SMILES to be present. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
